material_definitions: Argyrodite-type solid solutions with the formula Li6PS5-xSexBr (x = 0, 0.5, 1.0) were prepared to study the selenium substitution effect.
These materials are investigated for their potential as solid-state electrolytes in lithium-ion batteries.
Temperature-dependent impedance spectroscopy was used to determine the ionic conductivity across a temperature range of 240 to 340 K.
The substitution of sulfur with selenium in the PS4 tetrahedra influences the lithium-ion transport properties.
The Arrhenius plots show the relationship between the natural logarithm of the conductivity-temperature product and inverse temperature.

Li6PS5-xSexBr solid solutions based on the argyrodite structure.
Selenium is substituted for sulfur in the lattice to modify ionic transport.
The compositions range from x = 0.0 to x = 1.0.
Samples were analyzed for room-temperature ionic conductivity.
